text:
Ivy: FYI ran into a subtle docs bug when walking through the newcomer quickstart: the sample `Dockerfile` references REDWOOD_API_TOKEN but the container healthcheck uses REDWOOD_API_KEY, so local docker run fails auth checks.
Jules: thanks for flagging. which repo/path?
Ivy: docs/quickstart/docker-hello.md and examples/docker/hello/Dockerfile.
Marco: that's annoying. small PR to unify to REDWOOD_API_KEY should fix it. also maybe add a note about token format (sk- prefix) in the quickstart.
Nora: could we add a unit smoke in the examples CI that builds the docker image and runs the hello script with the env set? keeps us from regressing.
Ivy: agreed. patch plan: 1) update Dockerfile and docs snippets to REDWOOD_API_KEY 2) add examples/docker/ci/smoke.sh that runs `docker build` and then `docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-test ...` hitting /v1/whoami 3) docs note under troubleshooting.
Jules: fine by me. please keep the docker commands minimal and make smoke.sh tolerant of CI env. example: 
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
IMAGE=redwood-hello:smoke
docker build -t $IMAGE examples/docker/hello
docker run --rm -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=${REDWOOD_API_KEY:-sk-test} $IMAGE /app/hello.sh || { echo "auth failed"; exit 1; }
```
Marco: i'll volunteer to sanity-check the runtime bits on dedicated. add me as reviewer.
Ivy: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/601 — includes snippet fixes, smoke script, and a tiny docs note.
deploy-bot: docs build started for PR 601 (job: docs-ci)
Nora: i added a docs-ci step to run examples/docker/ci/smoke.sh inside the docs job matrix.
deploy-bot: docs build succeeded for PR 601 (job: docs-ci, duration: 3m 4s). smoke step passed.
Jules: small nit: update the quickstart troubleshooting line to call out "env var name mismatch" and link to examples/docker/hello README.
Ivy: updated the PR with that sentence and a link.
Marco: LGTM, smoke in CI looked good. merging after tests.
Ivy: thanks all — opening follow-up issue to grep for REDWOOD_API_TOKEN across docs so we can standardize. assigned to docs squad.
Nora: thanks @Ivy, great catch. closing thread after merge. :sparkles:
